text:
Maya Chen: spotting increased 500s from embed-service on prod-us-west since 23:45 UTC. appears related to recent kv-shard change. requesting hotfix window 23:55-00:05 UTC to push v2.1.10-hotfix. can we fast-track?
Tom Alvarez: pinging ops & qa. if CI green we can try a short canary-skip, need written ack from ops.
Priya Singh: Ops can support a 5m canary skip if QA certs done in parallel and we keep a 30m pin afterwards. what's rollback gate?
Maya Chen: CI green, artifact: v2.1.10-hotfix (kv-shard bounds + null-check). rollback if error-rate >1% OR any user-facing 5xx spike >1% sustained for 2m.
QA Runner: I'll run smoke + integration suite now. ETA ~7m. Will post results.
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.1.10-hotfix -> prod-us-west (4 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-6314012222. changelog: https://internal/redwood/deploys/6314012222
Tom Alvarez: ops ack: "we can allow canary=false for this window, ops standing by for immediate unpin/rollback." +ops
OpsBot: opsbot: ack. rollback playbook: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/embed-rollback.md. auto-unpin disabled for this run.
QA Runner: smoke complete: all critical flows pass. perf quick-check OK. integration hits one flaky test (non-blocking). :thumbsup:
Maya Chen: Priya, please apply pool pin once deploy starts: `trafficctl pin --pool us-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.1.10-hotfix --note "auto-hotfix-6314012222"`
Priya Singh: running pin now.
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied to pool us-hotfix. LB propagation to 2 edges confirmed.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/4 ready). healthcheck path=/ready expected 200.
Tom Alvarez: monitoring configured: slo-alerts suppressed for 20m, trace sampling increased. rollback trigger reiterated in thread.
Maya Chen: tagging product-oncall for visibility @product-oncall — this impacts a subset of embedding customers.
QA Runner: quick perf note: initial replica warmup causing 95p latency spike at 90s mark, stabilizes after 3m. no correctness regression.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout progress 2/4 ready. no errors.
Tom Alvarez: holding final rollout until 6m steady. if 502s exceed 1.5% for 2m, rollback and unpin.
OpsBot: opsbot: acknowledged. executing synthetic checks.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout complete (4/4 ready). run_id=deploy-6314012222. live traffic routed to new version.
Priya Singh: leaving pin for 30m as discussed, then auto-unpin. set: `trafficctl unpin --after 30m --pool us-hotfix --service embed-service`
Maya Chen: release-notes draft: "embed-service v2.1.10-hotfix: fixes kv-shard boundary null-check causing elevated 5xx in us-west. Deployed 23:55-00:05 UTC, pinned to us-hotfix pool for 30m and monitored. QA passed. Rollback criteria documented."
Tom Alvarez: I'll post to #release-notes in 10m after watch window. great job team.
QA Runner: 10m watch done, metrics stable, no error spike. LGTM.
Maya Chen: closing thread, opening follow-up ticket to root-cause warmup behavior on new replicas. :white_check_mark:
